name: zep-context
description: Get context about the user and the business from Zep, and save important context that the user tells the assistant. Bundles a skill and the Zep Context MCP Server.

interface.longDescription: Zep Context connects ChatGPT and Codex to your Zep account. The assistant calls Zep only when a request needs it. When a request depends on you, the assistant reads your Zep user summary or searches your user graph. When a request asks about your organization's own knowledge, it finds the matching standalone graph and searches it. When you ask it to save context, or tell it a lasting fact or preference about yourself or your work, it saves a short fact to Zep and tells you what it saved. It does not save files, tool results, or full conversations. You sign in to Zep with OAuth. You need a Zep account with a project that has the Context MCP Server enabled. Standalone graphs are available only when your project has them.
defaultPrompt: What context do you have about me?
